meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可管理作者习惯、启动本地 Dashboard。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「记住我的写作习惯」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写网络小说时自动匹配趁手工具,并记住你的写作习惯
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在写网络小说,希望工具顺着你的习惯走
copy.tagline_en: Auto-match the right writing tools and remember your habits as you draft web novels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and want tools that adapt to your habits

howto.what: 装好后，story 是网文工具箱的入口：它按你的需求把请求转给写长篇、拆文、扫榜等具体技能，本身还能记住作者习惯、打开本地工作台、检查工具箱版本更新。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story 或 /网文，或说「我想写小说」「记住我的写作习惯」「打开工作台」等时触发；若没说长篇还是短篇，会先问清篇幅再转。

say.note: 未指定篇幅时会先问长篇还是短篇

say.text: 记住我的写作习惯：我不写第一人称
say.note: 写入工作区的 .story/作者记忆/
启动本地 Dashboard 并返回本机地址

howto.what_en: story is the entry point of a web-novel toolbox: it routes your request to the matching skill (long/short writing, story analysis, ranking scans, etc.), and can also manage author habits, launch a local Dashboard and check for version updates.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /story or /网文, or phrases like “I want to write a novel”, “remember my writing habits”, “open the workspace”. If long or short form isn't stated, it asks first.

say_en.text: I want to write a novel
say_en.note: It asks long or short form first

say_en.text: Remember my writing habit: no first person
